description:
"Transform into a beast, fearing nearby enemies for |cffffff3|r seconds.

While transformed and in combat, abilities generate |cffffff15|r Fury. When you have |cffffff1000|r, this ability becomes Rampage, which increases your damage done by |cffffff15|r%, Movement Speed by |cffffff20|r%, and removes the cost of all Werewolf abilities for |cffffff20|r seconds. 

While slotted, your Stamina Recovery is increased by |cffffff15|r%."
